items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I went in there and got a lot of inspiration from Paul. Paul talked to Paul and he told me to stick with it.

ctx.x: I remember I used to hear my parents too. Well, I used to go, I went in there and got a lot of inspiration from Paul. Paul talked to Paul and he told me to stick with it. And I, the father used to go around and listen to his brother play, Louis Barbaran. He's still playing now.
Yeah, he plays in South Central.
